question: What direct result does Shiva initiation produce according to the Malini statement?
premises: Shiva initiation grants eligibility for mantra.
The Malini statement presents initiation as a direct means to liberation.
inference: Therefore Shiva initiation is taught as a direct means to liberation as well as to mantra eligibility.
plain_english: Through Shiva initiation one also gains eligibility for mantra and liberation. Thus, in this statement of the Malini, initiation is taught as a direct means to liberation.
